checks: Selecting an already-authorized second account clears a stale review without a transaction or permission request.
Explicit second-account preference survives reload while still authorized.
Authorized account order changes preserve the explicitly selected client.
Revocation while account selection is reading discards the late authorized snapshot and retains the valid account.
Cross-tab disconnect during a delayed selection clears the preference and ignores the late response across reload.
Second exposed account signs the exact local payment; requested from, transfer and Paid receipt/state agree.
Already-authorized invoice handoff changes role and restores the same Paid record without another permission prompt.
Removing selected wallet permission clears the preference and prevents later silent reselection.
Tampered stored preference cannot add or select an address outside current wallet authorization.
Permission loss during signer lookup cannot trigger an implicit reconnection or transaction.
Fresh authorization check blocks a revoked selected address immediately before wallet submission.
A network change without a provider event is blocked before any wallet submission.
The full-address account selector fits a 390px viewport.
Disconnect and reload remove the preference and account choices.
environment: Isolated headless Chrome with injected wallet, real disposable Anvil chain 31337 and Flask; not actual MetaMask or Sepolia.
